landing.faq.quality.question: 我可以在這個網站上創建什麼？
landing.faq.quality.answer: Enter a prompt on the homepage, choose an aspect ratio, then generate with AI Image. Use the dedicated editor for reference-image changes, and the prompt library for posters, products, typography, infographics and UI concepts.
landing.faq.credits.question: 學分是如何計算的，失敗的任務會退款嗎？
landing.faq.credits.answer: 默认 FLUX.2 生成每张使用 8 积分，编辑每次使用 10 积分。其他模型积分以提交前报价为准。
landing.faq.commercial.question: Can I use generated images commercially?
landing.faq.commercial.answer: 商業用途取決於所選的型號、提供者條款、您的提示、上傳的資料以及所描繪的人員、品牌或角色的權利。在發布之前查看當前條款和相關提供者許可證；本網站不能授予提供者或第三方擁有的權利。
landing.faq.models.question: 現在有哪些人工智慧模型和工具可供實際使用？
landing.faq.models.answer: 可选择 Nano Banana、GPT Image、Seedream 和 FLUX 等已接入的图片模型。开放状态与积分以模型页面为准。
landing.faq.release_status.question: 我今天可以在這裡用 Wan 3.0 或 Seedance 2.5 生成嗎？
landing.faq.release_status.answer: 還沒有。 Wan 3.0 目前作為預覽和經過事實檢查的發布追蹤器而不是生成器呈現。 Seedance 2.5頁面目前提供免費的提示建構器和整合狀態；真正的付費影片產生使用 Seedance 2.0，直到 2.5 端點經過端到端驗證。
landing.faq.account.question: 我可以在登入前嘗試工作流程嗎？
landing.faq.account.answer: 是的。您可以寫一個提示，先選擇模型和長寬比，然後在生成時登入。您返回後，您的草稿將恢復。無需登入即可使用範例、指南和提示規劃工具。目前的新帳戶獎勵顯示在登入和註冊頁面上。
landing.faq.rewards.question: 每日簽到和推薦獎勵如何運作？
landing.faq.rewards.answer: 已登入的用戶每天可以簽入一次。連續 7 天獎勵 3、4、4、5、5、6 和 6 個學分，總共 33 個學分；缺席一天會重新開始連續記錄。推薦連結適用於過去 7 天內建立的帳戶，成功推薦後每人可獲得 10 個積分。重複、自我推薦和濫用的聲明不會得到獎勵。
landing.faq.privacy.question: 我的提示、上傳和結果是否公開？
landing.faq.privacy.answer: 預設情況下，它們不會公開顯示。提示、上傳和結果與您的帳戶關聯，並在需要完成任務時傳送至已配置的 AI 提供者。可以保留任務記錄以用於歷史記錄、下載、支援和安全性。避免使用敏感資訊並查看隱私權政策以獲取完整的資料處理詳細資訊。

tools.poster.outcome_1_description: 標題和支援副本是單獨引用的，因此模型不太可能將它們與視覺指令合併。
tools.poster.outcome_2_description: 活動海報、產品宣傳和招募圖片需要不同的重點。目的包含在生成的簡報中。

tools.poster.workflow_description: 使用生成作為第一個連貫的藝術指導，然後應用設計師在交付前使用的相同檢查。
tools.poster.step_1_description: 僅貼上核准的標題和支援副本。在產生之前驗證名稱、日期、價格和標點符號。
tools.poster.step_2_description: 選擇海報的任務、風格和格式。僅當真正的品牌或活動要求時才添加調色板。
tools.poster.step_3_description: 在更改多個變數之前檢查層次結構和可讀性。單一的控制變化使比較變得有用。
tools.poster.step_4_description: 以全尺寸檢查每個字符，確認對比度和安全邊距，然後在設計工具中修復或排版關鍵副本。
tools.poster.prompts_description: 這些例子展示了有用的約束。取代訊息、受眾和視覺方向，而不是複製每個形容詞。
tools.poster.prompt_1_body: 創作一張肖像展覽海報，其標題為“形式與記憶”，內斂的編輯網格，溫暖的象牙紙紋理和一個鈷焦點形狀。在標題下方留下一個乾淨的資訊區。
tools.poster.prompt_2_body: 為緊湊型檯燈製作 4:5 的發布海報。使用確切的標題“更好的聚焦光線”，黑暗的高級工作室場景和清晰的 CTA 面板，沒有發明的評論或折扣。
tools.poster.prompt_3_body: 創建一張友好的研討會海報，其確切標題為“製作、修補、分享”、分層剪紙形式、高文字對比度以及批准日期和地點線的空間。
tools.poster.guidance_description: 好的海報提示可以減少歧義。它們規定了哪些內容必須保持準確、哪些內容可以變化以及如何判斷最終資產。
tools.poster.tip_1: 保持主標題足夠短以支援可見的層次結構。
tools.poster.tip_2: 將日期、價格和合法副本放在一個明確命名的資訊區域中。
tools.poster.tip_3: 描述一種主導風格，而不是堆疊不相關的美學。
tools.poster.tip_4: 產生最終的縱橫比，並在每個邊緣附近留出安全空間。
tools.poster.limitation_title: 文字準確性仍需手動檢查
tools.poster.limitation_body: 該工具創建了光柵設計概念。它不提供可編輯的向量類型、列印出血或保證拼字。對於公共活動，請對圖像進行 100% 校對，驗證所需的聲明，並在必要時在可編輯的設計文件中重新建立關鍵版式。
tools.poster.faq_1_question: 我可以產生什麼類型的海報？
tools.poster.faq_1_answer: 此工作流程支援活動、產品推廣、編輯和招募概念。當在生成之前就知道所需的訊息和預期的位置時，它的效果最佳。
tools.poster.faq_2_answer: 並非總是如此。引用準確的副本可以提高說明的清晰度，但在使用海報之前仍然需要檢查每個字元、數字和標點符號。
tools.poster.faq_3_question: 我可以生成中文和英文海報嗎？
tools.poster.faq_3_answer: 生成器接受多語言副本，但準確性因語言、字體樣式和文字密度而異。使用經過批准的目標語言副本，並讓流利的審閱者校對結果。
tools.poster.faq_4_question: 我該選擇哪一個縱橫比？
tools.poster.faq_4_answer: 肖像適合印刷海報和垂直提要，方形適合緊湊的社交位置，風景適合橫幅或演示螢幕。盡可能產生最終展示位置。
tools.poster.faq_5_question: 我可以將輸出用於商業用途嗎？
tools.poster.faq_5_answer: 檢查服務條款、您的來源資料以及名稱、商標和活動聲明所附的權利。產生的輸出仍然需要法律和品牌審查。

tools.product_photo.outcomes_description: 此工作流程專為早期活動決策而設計：場景、燈光、構圖和視覺氛圍。當精確的產品保真度很重要時，它會明確其限制。
tools.product_photo.outcome_1_descriptio: 形狀、表面、顏色和包裝細節與情緒詞分開，因此產品描述保持中心位置。
tools.product_photo.outcome_2_descriptio: 工作室、生活方式、奢華和色塊預設避免了使產品難以評估的不相關的幻想細節。

tools.product_photo.step_2_description: 選擇適合頻道、受眾和產品類別的設定和照明方向，而不是最新的視覺趨勢。
tools.product_photo.step_3_description: 檢查對稱性、邊緣、帽子對齊、陰影、反射和比例。拒絕物理上不可能存在的有吸引力的圖像。
tools.product_photo.step_4_title: 與上市資產分開的概念

tools.product_photo.prompts_description: 產品提示應在添加氣氛之前描述可觀察到的事實。這些例子顯示如何保持主題的可識別性。
tools.product_photo.prompt_1_body: 30 毫升鈷玻璃精華瓶，配有白色滴管和空白標籤，以溫暖的象牙石、柔和的定向日光、逼真的玻璃亮點和一種內斂的植物裝飾為中心。
tools.product_photo.prompt_2_body: 一盞啞光黑色鋁製檯燈，帶有圓形底座和細長的鉸接臂，在胡桃木桌子上與視線齊平的位置拍攝，聚焦的暖光和乾淨的深色背景。
tools.product_photo.prompt_3_body: 一款細長的無品牌鋁製飲料罐，具有淺珊瑚色飾面、冷凝結和逼真的金屬反射，站在明亮的色塊廣告系列中的半透明冰上。
tools.product_photo.guidance_title: 描述相機可以驗證的事實
tools.product_photo.guidance_description: 特定的產品幾何形狀和材料語言比一長串通用品質形容詞產生更多可審查的概念。
tools.product_photo.tip_1: 在描述氣氛之前先說明形狀、尺寸和材質。
tools.product_photo.tip_2: 保持較少的道具數量，使產品始終成為焦點。
tools.product_photo.tip_3: 要求有接地的接觸陰影和合理的反射。
tools.product_photo.tip_4: 請勿要求產品未獲得的包裝聲明、評論或認證。
tools.product_photo.limitation_title: 這是文字到圖像的概念
tools.product_photo.limitation_body: 目前生成器不會上傳或儲存真實的產品照片。即使是詳細的描述也會產生幾何形狀、顏色和包裝的變化。對於市場清單或核准的活動資產，與真實的 SKU 進行比較，並在需要精確保真度時轉向參考影像編輯工作流程。
tools.product_photo.faq_1_question: 我可以上傳我的真實產品照片嗎？
tools.product_photo.faq_1_answer: 這個版本中沒有。目前的工具是根據書面產品簡介產生的。它顯然避免了聲稱啟用的文本到圖像模型不提供的參考圖像保留。
tools.product_photo.faq_2_question: 輸出適合電子商務主圖像嗎？
tools.product_photo.faq_2_answer: 除非已根據真實 SKU 和市場的合成媒體、背景和準確性要求仔細檢查生成的對象，否則請將其用作概念。
tools.product_photo.faq_3_question: 我應該包括哪些詳細資訊？
tools.product_photo.faq_3_answer: 描述產品類別、幾何形狀、尺寸、材料、表面處理、顏色、閉合、標籤處理以及不得發明的細節。
tools.product_photo.faq_4_question: 如何獲得一致的行銷活動風格？
tools.product_photo.faq_4_answer: 重複使用相同的設定、相機高度、燈光、背景和調色板。僅更改指定的產品事實，然後將接受的提示與每個批准的方向一起存檔。
tools.product_photo.faq_5_question: 它可以產生品牌包裝嗎？
tools.product_photo.faq_5_answer: 它可以嘗試可見的文本，但品牌標誌和受監管的包裝副本需要確切的權利和仔細的審查。對於早期概念來說，空白或通用標籤更安全。

tools.product_photo.faq_6_answer: 提交前，當前成本顯示在生成按鈕旁邊。在花費積分購買其他變體之前，請完善書面摘要。

tools.youtube_thumbnail.meta_description: 創建原創的 16:9 YouTube 縮圖概念，具有清晰的焦點主題、可讀的標題、好奇心和行動優先的視覺控制。

tools.youtube_thumbnail.description: 將影片標題和一個視覺創意轉換為專用的 16:9 縮圖。控制焦點主題、好奇心差距和情緒溫度，而不是要求通用影像提示來猜測什麼應該停止滾動。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.disclosure: 沙漏城市是為此頁面創建的編輯概念。產生的縮圖仍需要進行行動裝置大小的可讀性檢查、事實審查並遵守 YouTube 政策。

tools.youtube_thumbnail.tool_description: 這個工作空間將承諾、主題和好奇心分開。然後，它以原生 16:9 的比例建立一個受限的生成摘要，保持標題可見，並將構圖集中在一個視覺問題上。

tools.youtube_thumbnail.example_caption: 概念範例·標題是即時 HTML 覆蓋層
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_1_body: 強大的 YouTube 縮圖並不能概括整個影片。它做出了一個誠實的承諾，標題和開場幾秒鐘都可以實現。使用具體的主題和可見的結果；避免模糊的裝飾，這樣會引起注意而不設定期望。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_1_bullet: 說出觀看者首先應該注意到的物體、人物、地點或變形。
使縮圖的想法與影片標題保持一致，而不是重複每個單字。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_2_title: 專為手機大小的測試而設計
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_2_body: 大多數印像都是在小尺寸和擁擠的提要中進行判斷的。大的形狀、分離的值和簡短的標題在縮減中得以保留。即使全解析度影像看起來令人印象深刻，精美的道具、幾張臉和長句子通常也會陷入視覺噪音。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_2_bullet: 縮小結果，直到其寬度約為行動搜尋卡的寬度。
拒絕任何其焦點主題或標題需要一目了然才能解碼的結果。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_3_body: 當圖像顯示出不尋常的狀態並且視頻對其進行解釋時，就會產生好奇心差距。捏造的結果、虛假的指標和不相關的名人面孔可能會增加短期點擊量，但會損害觀眾的信任，並可能造成政策或權利問題。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_3_bullet: 展示影片中探討的真實問題、衝突或前後對比。
不要發明內容中沒有的產品、引言、反應、獎項或結果。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_4_body: 產生一個連貫的方向，然後只比較有意義的替代方案：更緊湊的裁剪、不同的色溫或更短的短語。將影片主題、縮圖版本、印象數和點擊率保存在一起，以便未來的決策基於觀眾證據而不是個人品味。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_4_bullet: 改變變體之間的一個主要變量，這樣比較就能教你一些東西。
除了觀看時長之外還判斷點擊率；立即離開的點擊並不是一個有用的勝利。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.faq_1_question: 這個 AI YouTube 縮圖產生器可以輸出 16:9 的圖像嗎？
tools.youtube_thumbnail.faq_1_answer: 是的。它要求原生橫向 16:9 影像，該影像適合 YouTube 縮圖，並避免透過破壞性裁剪強制採用 4:3 概念。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.faq_2_answer: 沒有圖像模型可以保證完美的可見文字。提示引用您批准的標題並限制額外的副本，但您必須校對每個字符，並且可能需要在編輯器中替換關鍵文本。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.faq_3_question: 我可以複製其他創作者的縮圖樣式嗎？
tools.youtube_thumbnail.faq_3_answer: 使用類型層級的指導，例如紀錄片、有趣的實驗或電影懸疑片。避免詢問可識別的在世創作者的確切風格、肖像、標誌或受保護的視覺資產。
tools.youtube_thumbnail.faq_4_question: 縮圖應該使用多少個字？
tools.youtube_thumbnail.faq_4_answer: 沒有通用的數字，但字數越少，小字號通常讀起來越好。使用最短的短語來增加影片標題中尚未明顯的視覺承諾。

tools.video.section_1_body: 影片提示需要動詞和順序。說明開啟條件、物理變化和最終狀態。僅描述美麗的主題會讓模型發明運動，這通常會產生漂移的相機、不穩定的幾何形狀或永遠無法解決的動作。
tools.video.section_1_bullet_1: 使用可以在五到八秒內完成的開始、發展和最後節拍。
tools.video.section_1_bullet_2: 描述可觀察到的運動，例如展開、轉動、上升或穿過框架。
tools.video.section_2_title: 給相機一項明確的工作
tools.video.section_2_body: 相機指令應該支援動作而不是與之競爭。鎖定的框架揭示了轉變；緩慢的推動會增加註意力；橫向軌道跟隨旅行。將軌道、變焦、起重機和手持語言堆疊在一個短片中通常會降低連續性。
tools.video.section_2_bullet_1: 選擇一個主導動作和穩定的主體關係。
tools.video.section_2_bullet_2: 當主體的準確性比視覺效果更重要時，請使用鎖定或溫和的相機。
tools.video.section_3_title: 將持續時間與創意相匹配
tools.video.section_3_body: 五秒鐘適合一個展示、手勢或產品時刻。八秒給了兩階段的變形空間以喘息。時間越長不一定越好：每一次額外的節拍都會增加成本，並為身份漂移或不需要的物體創造更多機會。
tools.video.section_3_bullet_1: 用五秒的時間，一次果斷的行動，一次射擊。
tools.video.section_3_bullet_2: 僅當提示包含可讀的第二拍子時才使用八秒。
tools.video.section_4_body: 觀看一次故事，然後仔細檢查剪輯中的形狀變化、重複物件、閃爍、不安全細節和突然的鏡頭跳躍。僅在檢查主題、聲明、肖像權、音訊和最終目的地後，生成的影片才是製作資產。
tools.video.section_4_bullet_1: 比較第一幀、中間幀和最後一幀的身份和幾何形狀。
tools.video.section_4_bullet_2: 將接受的提示、格式和持續時間保留在核准的匯出旁。
tools.video.faq_1_question: 這是真正的人工智慧影片產生器還是故事板工具？
tools.video.faq_1_answer: 這是一個有效的人工智慧文字轉視頻工作區。該表單提交 Seedance 2.0 任務，保持處理狀態更新，並在完成時直接顯示可播放的影片。
tools.video.faq_2_question: 有哪些格式和持續時間可用？
tools.video.faq_2_answer: 該頁面提供 16:9、9:16 和 1:1 格式，並在 720p 下控制 5 或 8 秒的持續時間。這些選擇涵蓋了常見的景觀、垂直和方形佈局，同時保持成本可預測。
tools.video.faq_3_question: 為什麼影片生成比影像生成花費更長的時間？
tools.video.faq_3_answer: 該模型必須創建許多時間一致的幀而不是一張圖像。佇列負載和持續時間會影響渲染時間，因此任務保持非同步狀態，可能需要幾分鐘的時間。
tools.video.faq_4_question: 如果提供者任務失敗會發生什麼？
tools.video.faq_4_answer: 失敗的任務被標記為失敗，並且其消耗的積分由現有事務任務系統恢復。臨時狀態錯誤在最終超時之前仍然可以重試。
tools.video.faq_5_question: 我可以產生真人或受版權保護的角色的影片嗎？
tools.video.faq_5_answer: 僅使用您有權使用的人物、角色、音樂和來源材料。請勿創建欺騙性冒充、未經同意的親密資料或誤導性證據，並審查提供者和目的地平台政策。

tools.background_remover.meta_descriptio: 上傳一張照片，刪除其背景並使用互動式前後顯示檢查透明 PNG。
tools.background_remover.title: 刪除背景。保持銷售對象的優勢。
tools.background_remover.description: 上傳一張圖像並使用專門建立的分割模型分離前景。透過即時全面比較檢查結果，然後下載產品卡、簡報、創作者資產或合成的透明 PNG。
tools.background_remover.disclosure: 機器人燈示範兩側使用完全相同的透明前景；左邊的階段是在瀏覽器中組成的。它演示了邊緣檢查，而不是聲明提供者的結果。
tools.background_remover.tool_title: 在一處上傳、隔離和檢查
tools.background_remover.tool_descriptio: 此文件保持附加到您經過驗證的工作區，同時專用分段服務建立透明結果以進行可拖曳比較。困難的頭髮、玻璃和運動模糊仍然需要仔細審查。
tools.background_remover.example_title: 拖曳分隔線，或觀看自動邊緣掃描
tools.background_remover.section_1_title: 給模型一個可分離的主題
tools.background_remover.section_1_body: 當主體具有清晰的輪廓且與周圍環境形成足夠的對比度時，背景去除最可靠。重疊的物件、嚴重的運動模糊和被幀裁剪的主體會產生不確定的邊界，沒有介面可以完全恢復。
tools.background_remover.section_1_bulle: 使用最高解析度的原始螢幕截圖而不是壓縮的螢幕截圖。
盡可能將完整的產品、人物或物件保留在框架內。
tools.background_remover.section_2_body: 頭髮、毛皮、羽毛、半透明織物、玻璃、煙霧和反射包含部分透明度。放大淺色和深色背景；在棋盤上看起來正確的邊緣在放置在飽和的活動顏色上後可能會顯示光暈。
tools.background_remover.section_2_bulle: 分別檢查薄結構，如皮帶、手柄、輻條和手指。
尋找反光或蒼白邊緣周圍舊背景的顏色溢出。
tools.background_remover.section_3_title: 使用透明度作為生產層
tools.background_remover.section_3_body: 乾淨的剪紙並不自動成為成品圖像。添加適合目的地的畫布、逼真的接觸陰影和一致的比例。市場主要圖像、廣告和編輯合成都有不同的準確性和揭露要求。
tools.background_remover.section_3_bulle: 在每一份經批准的透明出口旁保留一份未動過的原件。
請勿新增錯誤地變更產品尺寸、內容或用途的新情境。
tools.background_remover.section_4_title: 使用移動邊界查看結果
tools.background_remover.section_4_body: 固定的並排對使得微小的幾何變化難以被注意到。清掃分隔線將原始結果和結果放置在相同的座標上，因此缺失的角落、柔化的邊緣和剩餘的背景在邊界交叉的地方變得清晰可見。
tools.background_remover.section_4_bulle: 將分隔線暫停在高細節區域上方並比較相同的像素。
在至少一種淺色和一種深色的最終背景上測試導出的 PNG。
tools.background_remover.faq_1_question: 該工具是否返回透明 PNG？
tools.background_remover.faq_1_answer: 是的。處理服務傳回帶有 Alpha 通道的 PNG，結果顯示在棋盤上，以便在下載之前檢查透明度。
tools.background_remover.faq_2_answer: 具有清晰前景主體、可見邊界和適度背景對比度的高解析度影像效果最佳。微小的物體、運動模糊、霧和重疊的透明物體都比較困難。
tools.background_remover.faq_3_question: 我上傳的圖片是公開的嗎？
tools.background_remover.faq_3_answer: 該工具需要登入並使用網站配置的儲存路徑，以便提供者可以檢索來源。不要上傳機密或受限資料，並查看網站的隱私權政策和提供者條款。
tools.background_remover.faq_4_question: 為什麼我應該檢查不同顏色的切口？
tools.background_remover.faq_4_answer: 白色光暈、深色邊緣和舊背景顏色溢出可能隱藏在一個背景上，而在另一個背景上變得明顯。測試淺色和深色表面是一種快速的邊緣品質檢查。
tools.background_remover.faq_5_question: 當背景刪除失敗時會發生什麼？
tools.background_remover.faq_5_answer: 提供者失敗會進入與其他付費人工智慧工具相同的最終任務狀態和信用恢復流程。然後，您可以使用更清晰或更高解析度的來源重試。
tools.background_remover.upload_hint: JPG、PNG 或 WebP，最大 10 MB。使用具有清晰前景的全解析度來源。
tools.background_remover.result_hint: 處理後，將分隔線拖曳過原始透明結果。

tools.matcha_filter.benefit_1_body: 减少白色、阴影与肤色中的多余绿色，同时尽量保留真正的抹茶、植物和绿色服装等物体原有质感。
tools.matcha_filter.benefit_2_body: 处理指令会锁定人物身份、表情、姿势和五官结构，让结果更像校色，而不是重新生成一张人像。

tools.matcha_filter.step_2_body: AI 识别人为绿色偏色，并重建更中性的白平衡。
tools.matcha_filter.step_3_body: 在同一画面拖动对比，检查人物和物体后下载结果。
tools.matcha_filter.faq_1_answer: 它通常是一种偏绿或鼠尾草绿色的风格化调色，会让肤色、白色和阴影整体染绿。此工具用于减弱这种偏色并恢复更自然的色彩平衡。
tools.matcha_filter.faq_2_question: 会把照片里真正的绿色物体也去掉吗？
tools.matcha_filter.faq_2_answer: 处理指令要求模型保留真实物体和材质，包括真正的抹茶和植物。但 AI 编辑结果仍可能变化，重要颜色请在使用前仔细核对。
tools.matcha_filter.faq_3_question: 会改变人物面部或背景吗？
tools.matcha_filter.faq_3_answer: 工作流会明确要求保持人物身份、姿势、物体与构图，并使用较保守的编辑强度。但生成式编辑无法保证像素级一致，请仔细检查前后对比。
tools.matcha_filter.faq_4_answer: 支持 10 MB 以内的 JPG、PNG 和 WebP。清晰、高分辨率的原图能提供更多可保留的色彩与纹理信息。
tools.matcha_filter.faq_5_question: 页面上的前后对比是保证效果吗？
tools.matcha_filter.faq_5_answer: 不是。它是为了演示目标校色方向而制作的原创示例。实际输出取决于原图和 AI 服务商，请在发布前检查结果。

homepage_prompt_library.items.spotlight_: 全身鏡頭，一名現代舞者獨自在劇院聚光燈下起舞。攝影機緩慢繞行半圈，衣擺在光束中旋轉，細微塵埃懸浮。深黑舞台、優雅克制的動作，伴隨柔和腳步聲和寬闊大廳混響。
homepage_prompt_library.items.wild_horse: 一小群野馬在黃金時刻奔過陽光照耀的平原。低機位攝影機與馬群並行跟拍，馬蹄後揚起塵土，長長的影子掃過地面。自然準確的動態、溫暖逆光，伴隨馬蹄、呼吸與呼嘯風聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.glass_city: 攝影機在現代玻璃高樓之間緩慢仰拍。金色日落倒影劃過建築立面，辦公室燈光逐盞亮起，雲層從上空移動。乾淨的建築電影攝影、輕微鏡頭光暈，伴隨遠處車流與平靜傍晚城市聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.fern_dewdr: 雨後新鮮蕨葉的極致微距鏡頭。一顆水滴在葉尖聚攏後慢動作墜落，焦點隨即轉移到另一顆在林間柔光中閃耀的露珠。淺景深、真實葉片紋理，伴隨細雨、昆蟲與安靜森林環境聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.underwater: 水下攝影機仰望清澈的青綠色海浪在頭頂捲起並破碎。陽光穿過氣泡散射，鏡頭輕輕上升接近水面。自然可信的海水運動、清晰水下細節，伴隨低頻水流和被水體過濾的浪聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.snow_cabin: 松林中的溫暖木屋迎來第一場大雪。攝影機從小溪對岸緩慢推進，煙囪炊煙隨風彎曲，金色窗燈輕輕閃爍。舒適電影寫實風格，積雪壓上枝頭，伴隨流水、風聲與遠處爐火噼啪聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.biolumines: 月光下的森林小徑兩旁生長著會發光的蘑菇，細小光粒在空氣中漂浮。攝影機以步行速度向前移動，植物成片柔和亮起，樹枝在頭頂搖曳。深青色魔幻寫實風格，伴隨昆蟲、樹葉和細微光能嗡鳴。
homepage_prompt_library.items.crystal_ca: 巨大的水晶洞穴環繞一池清澈地下水。攝影機從半透明晶體之間緩慢下降，一束日光折射成移動的彩虹。細緻礦物紋理、涼薄霧氣，伴隨水滴落入池中產生的悠長自然回聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.storm_clif: 航拍鏡頭靠近暴風雨來臨前的黑色海岸懸崖。海浪在下方炸開白色水霧，強風壓彎草地，遠處閃電短暫照亮海岸線。克制無人機運動、自然暗色調，伴隨滾雷、海嘯般浪聲與立體風聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.chef_plati: 溫暖開放式廚房中，廚師完成一道精緻料理的近距離鏡頭。攝影機沿操作台輕輕滑動，鑷子放下最後一片香草，蒸汽升騰，醬汁反射燈光。真實手部與精準動作、淺景深，伴隨安靜廚房和細膩食物聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.mountain_h: 日出時，一名獨行徒步者站在雲海上方狹窄的高山山脊。無人機緩慢環繞，露出遠處群峰，外套和背包帶隨風擺動。遼闊自然尺度、克制暖色調、穩定人物姿態，伴隨沉浸式高山風聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.rainy_port: 一名年輕人在雨後的商店屋簷下等待，電影感街頭肖像。攝影機緩慢推近，霓虹倒影掠過面部，微風吹動髮絲，背景車輛柔和經過。自然皮膚紋理、50mm 鏡頭質感，伴隨雨聲與壓低的城市聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.elder_craf: 紀錄片式近景，一位年長匠人在工作室窗邊雕刻小塊木料。焦點跟隨雙手，薄木屑捲曲落下，晨光照亮浮塵。真實皮膚細節、磨舊工具和耐心節奏，伴隨木料刮擦與安靜室內環境聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.boxer_back: 拳手坐在後台纏好雙手，準備走入賽場。輕微手持鏡頭從繃帶移動到專注的神情，肩膀隨控制呼吸起伏，門外賽場燈光閃動。冷色陰影和粗糙寫實感，伴隨布料摩擦、呼吸與遠處觀眾聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.cellist_wi: 大提琴手在安靜老房間的高窗旁演奏，側面人物構圖。攝影機緩慢跟隨琴弓移動，窗簾被午後微風吹動，塵埃穿過光束。精緻自然光、富有表現力的手部動作，伴隨共鳴琴聲與細微房間環境聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.perfume_re: 無品牌琥珀色香水瓶立在濕潤黑色岩石上。攝影機精確緩慢環繞，一道窄光掃過玻璃，水滴沿瓶身滑下，薄霧在後方捲曲。高級產品電影攝影、深邃陰影和清晰高光，配以細膩玻璃與水滴聲音。
homepage_prompt_library.items.watch_mech: 無品牌機械腕錶機芯的極致微距旅程。攝影機穿過轉動齒輪，拋光零件逐一咬合，擺輪開始規律振動。受控棚拍高光、準確金屬紋理、純黑背景，伴隨精準滴答聲和細小機械卡扣聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.coffee_pac: 極簡無品牌咖啡袋在暖色石台上緩慢旋轉，烘焙咖啡豆從周圍落下並自然停穩。柔和晨光劃過包裝，呈現紙張紋理與升騰香氣。高級桌面構圖、土地色調，伴隨豆粒碰撞和輕柔咖啡館環境聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.sneaker_la: 原創無品牌運動鞋懸浮在乾淨的攝影棚平台上，並在空中緩慢轉動。彩色光線沿鞋底移動，細粉隨輕微旋轉升起。清晰材質細節、運動能量、暗色漸變背景，伴隨受控破風聲和柔和落地聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.skincare_w: 簡潔無品牌護膚瓶從晶瑩清水中上升，最後直立於淺色石台。攝影機向上跟隨，漣漪擴散、氣泡釋放，柔和日光在水面折射。乾淨美妝風格、白色與水藍配色，伴隨輕柔水花和安靜空間聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.electric_b: 流線型無品牌電動自行車停在暗色建築攝影棚。緩慢跟拍鏡頭從後輪移向車把，細窄燈帶揭示車架，輪胎輕微旋轉，塵埃劃過地面。精密工程氛圍，伴隨細微電機嗡鳴和清晰機械聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.ramen_stea: 午夜小木櫃台上放下一碗拉麵的電影感近景。蒸汽穿過溫暖燈籠光線，麵條被緩慢夾起，湯麵在下方泛起漣漪。豐富食物紋理、淺景深和親密構圖，伴隨麵湯、陶瓷接觸與安靜小店環境聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.citrus_spl: 新鮮橙子、檸檬和西柚片落入清澈氣泡水，以高速攝影慢動作呈現。攝影機固定，氣泡與扭轉果汁水帶捕捉明亮夏日光線。清晰商業微距、鮮豔自然色彩、乾淨白背景和層次豐富的水花聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.chocolate_: 極致微距鏡頭，光澤深色巧克力連續淋在雕塑感甜點表面。攝影機橫向滑動，塗層自然鋪開並凝固，形成完美反射。奢華低調光線、準確質地和暖色高光，伴隨傾倒、輕敲和細微廚房聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.bread_morn: 黎明時，新鮮麵包從小烘焙坊的石爐中出爐。輕柔手持鏡頭跟隨麵包師將麵包放上木架，麵粉懸浮在金色光線中，麵包冷卻時外殼輕響。溫暖紀錄片寫實感與安靜清晨烘焙坊聲音。
homepage_prompt_library.items.sushi_coun: 廚師在乾淨木質吧台製作一貫握壽司。鏡頭從俯拍緊密過渡到側面，跟隨精準手指、刷子塗上最後光澤，再將盤子推向客人。自然食材紋理、克制極簡美學，伴隨刀具、刷子與柔和檯面聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.summer_moc: 在高透明玻璃杯中調製明亮的無酒精夏日飲品。冰塊落入，柑橘皮繞過冰塊，香草隨氣泡水上升，杯壁逐漸凝結水珠。平滑微距推進、陽光花園虛化背景，伴隨清脆冰塊、氣泡和傾倒聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.old_town_m: 店鋪開門前，穩定器鏡頭穿過安靜老城街道。布質遮陽棚展開，自行車經過，晨光逐漸照上磨舊石牆。觀察式旅行電影、自然暖色，伴隨腳步、捲簾門、鳥鳴與遠處交談聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.alpine_clo: 航拍攝影機從岩石山脊升起，滑過緩慢流動的雲海，露出遠方陽光照亮的群峰。平滑不間斷運動、遼闊真實尺度、清澈晨間空氣和輕微鏡頭光暈，伴隨高空風聲與遙遠自然環境聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.night_mono: 流線型無品牌單軌列車在雨夜城市高樓之間行駛。攝影機與列車並行跟拍，溫暖車窗形成光帶，路面倒影從下方滑過，薄霧包裹遠處建築。高級未來旅行風格，伴隨軌道嗡鳴、雨聲與安靜車流。
homepage_prompt_library.items.winter_esc: 第一視角沿雪林小徑走向藍調時刻裡亮著暖燈的木屋。攝影機以平靜步行節奏前進，新雪飄落，炊煙在屋頂捲曲，木門輕輕打開。溫暖旅行氛圍，伴隨踩雪聲、冬風與屋內爐火聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.coastal_ro: 高空無人機跟隨一輛無品牌小型汽車，沿海面上方蜿蜒公路行駛。陽光穿破雲層，海浪衝擊懸崖，車輛在明暗之間穿行。遼闊旅行廣告質感、平穩節奏，伴隨海風與細微道路聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.market_wal: 人眼高度鏡頭穿過熱鬧的露天晨市。攝影機經過彩色蔬果、升騰食物蒸汽、交換籃子的雙手和頭頂隨風移動的布棚。真實紀錄片動態、明亮自然光，伴隨人聲、腳步、炊具與街道環境聲，不出現品牌。
homepage_prompt_library.items.robot_gard: 一台原創的磨舊小機器人在植物茂盛的溫室裡細心澆花。攝影機緩慢環繞，機械手指扶正彎曲花莖，陽光從葉間閃動，水滴在金屬上發亮。溫暖希望感科幻風格，伴隨伺服聲、水聲與昆蟲環境聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.terrarium_: 微型未來城市生長在暗色書桌上的玻璃生態缸中。微距攝影機穿過凝結水汽推進，微小交通燈開始移動，屋頂花園展開，穹頂下形成雲層。真實微縮尺度和豐富景深，伴隨精密機械與封閉雨聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.orbital_gr: 安靜的軌道溫室中，宇航員漂浮在成排綠色植物之間，地球在寬大舷窗外轉動。攝影機失重般緩慢後退，葉片隨通風氣流搖動，水滴懸浮。真實太空光線，伴隨柔和系統嗡鳴與無線電環境聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.holographi: 巨大的暗色檔案館甦醒，半透明地圖和記憶從數百張桌面升起。攝影機沿中央通道滑行，一名管理員抬手整理頭頂層疊光影。優雅克制的科幻設計、藍色體積光，伴隨電子脈衝與寬闊空間回聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.floating_t: 一輛緊湊空中纜車在明亮雲海上方的綠色浮島之間行駛。廣角鏡頭從後方跟隨，瀑布落入霧中，鳥群穿過線路。可信奇幻工程、清澈日光和平穩運動，伴隨纜繩振動、風聲與遠處水聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.clockwork_: 由巨型黃銅齒輪構成的山谷在日出時開始運轉。攝影機貼近河流低空飛行，齒輪依次轉動，橋樑展開，暖光劃過舊金屬。史詩機械景觀和細緻尺度，伴隨規律卡扣、低沉轉動與流水聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.paper_drag: 一隻手工紙龍在藝術家的桌面醒來，小心走過鉛筆與折疊草圖。低機位桌面攝影機跟隨，翅膀展開，散落紙張被微風吹起，暖色臺燈輕輕閃爍。可觸摸定格動畫質感，伴隨紙張摩擦和細小腳步聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.floating_i: 古老花園島嶼在日出雲層上方漂浮。攝影機從石拱下穿過並上升，露出落入天空的瀑布，樹木在微風中彎曲。繪畫感電影奇幻風格、宏大景深，伴隨鳥鳴、奔流水聲與空靈音樂氛圍。
homepage_prompt_library.items.koi_conste: 兩尾水彩錦鯉在有紋理的紙面上盤旋。彩繪尾巴化為光點，攝影機向上升起，錦鯉游入深夜天空並連接成星座。優雅手繪動畫、流暢變形，伴隨水筆聲音與細膩風鈴。
homepage_prompt_library.items.umbrella_p: 數十把彩色雨傘在狹窄庭院上方緩慢旋轉，組成精確螺旋傳送門。攝影機垂直仰望並向中心上升，陽光從形狀之間閃過，下方絲帶擺動。輕巧實景奇幻風格，伴隨布料、風聲與明快打擊聲。
homepage_prompt_library.items.silk_ribbo: 長條半透明絲帶在空曠陽光空間裡被無形風塑造。固定廣角攝影機觀察絲帶交織、分離，短暫形成一道波浪後舒展。精緻抽象運動、珊瑚橙與青綠色配色，伴隨柔軟布料和空靈空間聲音。
homepage_prompt_library.items.miniature_: 微型手工烘焙坊在黎明前甦醒。黏土麵包師揉製麵團，小烤爐亮起，托盤移上木架，攝影機從門口輕輕推進。迷人定格動畫、清晰手作紋理和溫暖燈光，伴隨迷你炊具與輕快烘焙坊環境聲。

nano_site.home.title: Nano Banana 2.1 AI Image Generator & Editor
nano_site.home.description: Create and edit with the Nano Banana 2.1 workspace. Explore reference editing, prompt recipes, model comparisons and image generation in one focused interface.
nano_site.home.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 AI Image Generator
nano_site.home.intro: Turn an idea into an image. Write a prompt, bring your references, and choose the Nano Banana model that fits. Keep faces, products and the words in your picture in focus.
nano_site.home.section_0.title: What is Nano Banana 2.1?
nano_site.home.section_0.body:
Nano Banana 2.1 is Google's image generation and editing model, identified as gemini-nano-banana-2.1. Released on October 6, 2026, it updates Nano Banana 2. Use it to describe a new scene or plan changes to an existing image; the selected model and available controls determine the actual request.

Begin with the image's purpose. A catalog photo needs recognizable product details and space for copy. A poster needs an ordered layout and verified wording. This independent workspace helps you prepare those decisions before spending credits.
nano_site.home.section_1.title: Nano Banana 2.1 vs Nano Banana 2
nano_site.home.section_1.body:
An upgrade deserves a test with your own work. Keep a successful Nano Banana 2 brief, its reference files and the finished image. Prepare the same task for 2.1 and compare the features that matter: lettering, subject identity, layout and preserved details.

Keep both model names in your records. If a parameter is unavailable on one model, note the difference rather than hiding it in the comparison. The migration guide explains how to build a small acceptance set before changing an established workflow.
nano_site.home.section_2.title: Nano Banana 2.1 vs Pro: choose for the task
nano_site.home.section_2.body:
Pro and 2.1 are separate model choices. Define success before comparing them: a readable poster headline, a product that keeps its proportions, or a character whose identifying features survive an edit. A striking sample alone cannot answer all three questions.

Use the same prompt and references, then inspect the outputs at the size where people will use them. Include the quote and the number of corrections in your decision. Our Pro comparison guide provides a review method; we have not published a measured winner or a guaranteed speed advantage.
nano_site.home.section_3.title: Plan references, text and output shape
nano_site.home.section_3.body:
Give each reference a role: the first supplies product geometry, another supplies a color direction, and a layout sketch establishes placement. State which details must remain, such as a face shape, bottle silhouette or camera angle. Extra images help only when their purpose is clear.

Write important text exactly and specify its position. Choose a shape for the destination before requesting more detail: a square catalog card, portrait poster or wide banner. Available resolutions and reference limits can vary by model and service, so use the controls actually offered in the workbench.
nano_site.home.section_4.title: How to use the workbench
nano_site.home.section_4.body:
选择任务，写好说明并确定比例。编辑图片时添加参考图，分别写清修改要求与保留要求。无需账号也能复制提示词或下载说明。

登录后即可生成。Nano Banana 2.1 单张 1K 生图或参考图编辑每次 8 积分。检查报价后提交一次，查看任务进度并下载结果。

nano_site.home.faq_2.question: Is Pro the same model as 2.1?
nano_site.home.faq_2.answer: No. They are separate model choices. Compare the same task, references, supported settings and actual quote before selecting one.
nano_site.home.faq_3.question: How do I write a prompt with readable text?
nano_site.home.faq_3.answer: Provide the exact wording in quotation marks, specify its location and keep the number of text blocks small. Inspect every letter at the final size; use editable manual text for critical labels.
nano_site.prompts.title: Nano Banana 2.1 Prompts: Products, Posters & Reference Edits
nano_site.prompts.description: Adapt original Nano Banana 2.1 prompts for product photos, readable posters, reference edits and scientific schematics. Copy a brief and review it step by step.
nano_site.prompts.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 prompts you can adapt
nano_site.prompts.intro: Start with the task you want to finish. Each recipe gives you a subject, composition and constraints to replace with your own details; the workbench lets you copy or save the brief.
nano_site.prompts.section_0.title: Build a prompt from five concrete decisions
nano_site.prompts.section_0.body:
Write the subject and its action, the composition, the lighting or material, any exact text, and the constraints. For example: one cobalt bottle, centered on pale stone, light from the left, no lettering, empty space above. Each part describes something you can inspect in the result.

Keep the first attempt focused. A wide-angle documentary photograph and a flat vector icon ask for different visual rules. Choose one direction, then describe the detail that makes it yours. Add words when they remove ambiguity, such as where a shadow falls or which object sits in front.
nano_site.prompts.section_1.title: Write product and character edits as change-and-preserve briefs
nano_site.prompts.section_1.body:
For a product edit, say: replace the background with a neutral studio wall; preserve the silhouette, label position, cap, reflections and crop. For a character, preserve face shape, hairstyle, clothing colors and distinguishing accessories while changing the pose or location.

Give each uploaded reference an explicit role. A subject photo provides identity; a style image provides color or lighting. If a result changes a required detail, make the next brief about that specific error. Repeating 'keep everything the same' is less useful than naming the features you will check.
nano_site.prompts.section_2.title: Create a poster with a readable text hierarchy
nano_site.prompts.section_2.body:
Put the headline and date in quotation marks and specify how many text blocks belong in the image. A useful starting brief might ask for one large headline near the top, a short date below and an uncluttered illustration in the lower half. Reserve space for a venue or fine print that you can typeset later.

Inspect spelling, punctuation and reading order at the final export size. Check for invented sponsors, duplicate letters and unwanted text in the background. For product ingredients, legal disclosures or a final logo, add verified lettering in a manual layer so it remains editable.
nano_site.prompts.section_3.title: Prompt a scientific schematic without inventing evidence
nano_site.prompts.section_3.body:
State the figure's role first: a conceptual workflow for explanation. Define the panels, exact labels and allowed arrows before describing the palette. The scientific recipe below uses sample preparation, measurement, analysis and review with no numerical values or experimental imagery.

Replace generic stages with terminology checked by a subject expert. If you need a chart, plot your actual dataset separately and combine it with an approved schematic in a layout tool. Keep the caption explicit about which parts are conceptual; the scientific figures guide includes a label-review checklist.
nano_site.prompts.faq_0.question: Do these prompts guarantee the same image?
nano_site.prompts.faq_0.answer: No. The model, references, settings and generation variability affect each result. A recipe supplies an inspectable brief; keep a baseline and change one requirement at a time.
nano_site.prompts.faq_1.question: Can I copy a prompt directly into the workbench?
nano_site.prompts.faq_1.answer: 可以。载入配方、替换主体、检查模型和积分报价后生成，也可以免费复制提示词或下载说明。
nano_site.comparison.title: Nano Banana 2.1 vs Pro: Compare the Same Image Brief
nano_site.comparison.description: Compare Nano Banana 2.1 and Pro with the same prompts and references. Review text, identity, edits and actual cost without unsupported quality rankings.
nano_site.comparison.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 vs Pro: which fits your image?
nano_site.comparison.intro: Choose around a task you can check. This guide separates model identity and available options from results that still need a real comparison.
nano_site.comparison.section_0.title: Start with the decision you need to make
nano_site.comparison.section_0.body:
Nano Banana 2.1 and Nano Banana Pro are separate image-model choices. Their official positioning helps narrow a shortlist, but it does not establish which one will meet a particular poster, product edit or character brief. Write down the required output before choosing.

A poster might pass only when the headline is correct and the hierarchy is clear. A product image might pass only when its silhouette, label and crop are preserved. Treat these as separate criteria; a pleasant color palette cannot compensate for a wrong product shape.
nano_site.comparison.section_1.title: Use the same prompt and references
nano_site.comparison.section_1.body:
Prepare one new-image brief and one reference-edit brief. Keep the wording, reference files and requested layout identical, and use the closest matching output shape and size. Record any settings that one model does not offer so the comparison can be understood later.

Keep the unedited output from each attempt. If you repair a title manually or crop an image, record that work separately. When budget allows, use more than one attempt for each task and show all attempts; selecting only a favorite conceals the revision effort.
nano_site.comparison.section_2.title: Review text, identity and composition separately
nano_site.comparison.section_2.body:
Read every requested word at the final viewing size. Check whether the result adds extra captions or changes punctuation. For references, compare distinctive facial features, product proportions, logos and camera angle with the original. For new scenes, inspect element placement and unwanted objects.

Use a simple record: pass, needs correction or unusable, followed by a specific reason. 'The bottle cap became wider' is useful; 'looks less professional' is difficult to act on. Decide which failures are acceptable before seeing the results so style preferences do not replace the original brief.
nano_site.comparison.section_3.title: Include cost and revision effort
nano_site.comparison.section_3.body:
记录本次积分报价与获得可用结果需要的修改次数。Nano Banana 2.1 单张 1K 生图或编辑每次 8 积分，Pro 每次 15 积分。

两者都可在工作台选择。请使用自己的提示词和参考图进行比较。这些是本站积分规则，不是 Google 官方定价或实测速度结果。
nano_site.comparison.faq_0.question: Is Nano Banana 2.1 always better than Pro?
nano_site.comparison.faq_0.answer: This page does not establish an overall winner. Test the same important task on both named models and compare failures, available settings, total cost and revision effort.
nano_site.comparison.faq_1.question: Can I compare them without generating images?
nano_site.comparison.faq_1.answer: You can compare documented inputs, controls and availability first. Comparing output quality requires actual results from each model with the test conditions recorded.
nano_site.pricing.title: Nano Banana 2.1 Pricing: Credits, Plans & API Costs
nano_site.pricing.description: Understand website credits, subscription plans and direct API costs for Nano Banana workflows. Check model-specific quotes before buying or generating.
nano_site.pricing.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 pricing, explained
nano_site.pricing.intro: There are two cost layers: a provider’s API bill and your account credits on this site. The plans below are site plans; they are not an official Google price list.
nano_site.pricing.section_0.title: Website credits are not API dollars
nano_site.pricing.section_0.body:
套餐为账号增加积分，每次任务按所选模型的报价消耗。{model} 默认 {resolution} 单张生成与编辑为 {credits} 积分，Nano Banana 2 为 {nano2}、Pro 为 {pro}、Lite 为 {lite} 积分。分辨率和数量会影响总额，以提交前报价为准。

购买前核对订单与续费规则，为修改和重试预留额度。
nano_site.pricing.section_1.title: Choose renewal or a one-time pack
nano_site.pricing.section_1.body:
A subscription is intended for regular work and renews according to its billing period. A one-time pack adds credits without automatic renewal. Check the pack validity, renewal terms and refund policy before checkout.

Estimate the number of iterations in a project. Ten useful finished images can require more than ten requests. If you are exploring a new model, start with a bounded test budget and decide on a larger plan after seeing whether the workflow fits.
nano_site.pricing.section_2.title: Before submitting a generation
nano_site.pricing.section_2.body:
Check the selected model, operation, shape and quoted credits. Ensure reference files are ready for an edit. Do not repeatedly submit because a result is taking time; inspect the task status first.

A failed provider task follows the site’s credit reversal workflow. A result that finishes successfully but does not match your creative preference is a different case. Read the refund policy and keep the task identifier when contacting support about a billing problem.
nano_site.pricing.section_3.title: Direct API costs need their own budget
nano_site.pricing.section_3.body:
Using fal directly requires a provider account and server-side credentials. Its bill is separate from a subscription to this website. Consult the current provider price for your chosen endpoint and output settings.

For an application, include storage, network transfer, retries and manual review in the budget. Cap concurrency and avoid retrying a submission whose status is unknown. Our API guide shows the queue workflow and where authentication belongs.
nano_site.pricing.faq_0.question: Does buying a plan enable every model?
nano_site.pricing.faq_0.answer: 已接入的 Nano Banana 模型可使用账户积分。生成器会在提交前显示所选模型与操作的积分报价。
nano_site.pricing.faq_1.question: Are the plans an official Google subscription?
nano_site.pricing.faq_1.answer: No. They are plans for this independently operated website.
nano_site.api.title: Nano Banana 2.1 API: fal Integration & Queue Guide
nano_site.api.description: Plan Nano Banana 2.1 API integration with fal generation and edit endpoints, server-side credentials, queue polling and safe request handling.
nano_site.api.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 API integration
nano_site.api.intro: Build against the exact endpoint. This guide describes a direct fal integration; it does not sell a public API supplied by this website.
nano_site.api.section_0.title: Choose generation or reference editing
nano_site.api.section_0.body:
fal documents google/nano-banana-2.1 for text-to-image and google/nano-banana-2.1/edit for image editing. Keep these separate in your application: an edit needs reference image URLs, while a new composition begins with a text brief.

Do not silently replace a failed request with a different model. Return a clear status and preserve the requested model identifier in your logs. This site’s private studio routes require its own signed-in account; a website API key is not a fal credential.
nano_site.api.section_1.title: Submit from your server
nano_site.api.section_1.body:
Store the provider key in your server’s secret store. Your browser sends the prompt and allowed settings to your server; the server validates input and submits the provider request. Never put a real key in a public code example, client bundle or shared screenshot.

The sample below is a request template. FAL_KEY is a placeholder environment variable, not a credential supplied by this page. Add ownership checks, rate limits and a cost ceiling before allowing an end user to create a task.
nano_site.api.section_2.title: Treat generation as a queue task
nano_site.api.section_2.body:
Save the provider request identifier when a submission succeeds. Poll status with a reasonable interval and fetch the result only after completion. A signed webhook can reduce polling, but verify its authenticity before changing task or billing state.

Retry safe status reads after temporary network failures. Do not blindly retry an ambiguous submission: a duplicate can create two billed tasks. Associate the request identifier with your application’s task and credit transaction so support can investigate a problem.
nano_site.api.section_3.title: Validate output settings and references
nano_site.api.section_3.body:
Use only settings supported by the chosen endpoint. Pin the desired output format and aspect ratio instead of forwarding arbitrary browser fields. If you accept image URLs, check their scheme and length, and control which storage locations your application can access.

Store the final image in storage you control when the workflow requires durable access. Return a task status instead of holding an HTTP request open for the entire generation. Test failure, timeout and cancellation paths before opening paid access.
nano_site.api.faq_0.question: Can I use a site subscription as a fal key?
nano_site.api.faq_0.answer: No. Direct fal access requires your own provider account and credentials. Site subscriptions and provider billing are separate.
nano_site.api.faq_1.question: Should the browser call fal with my key?
nano_site.api.faq_1.answer: No. Keep the credential on your server and apply validation and authorization before submission.
nano_site.free.title: Nano Banana 2.1 Free Options: What You Can Do
nano_site.free.description: Prepare Nano Banana 2.1 prompts without payment. Understand free preparation, account credits, model availability and the limits of a free image workflow.
nano_site.free.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 free: start with a clear brief
nano_site.free.intro: Prompt preparation is free here. Image generation depends on a connected model and account credits; this page does not promise unlimited free 2.1 images.
nano_site.free.section_0.title: What works without a payment
nano_site.free.section_0.body:
Write a prompt, choose an aspect ratio, preview a local reference, copy the brief and download it as a file. These preparation actions do not submit a provider generation and do not use credits. You can also read the prompt library and comparison guides without registering.

Use preparation time to remove contradictions from the brief. Specify the product or character, the intended output and the details that must remain. A careful brief does not guarantee an image, but it makes a future paid test easier to evaluate.
nano_site.free.section_1.title: Credits are conditional, not unlimited access
nano_site.free.section_1.body:
The website has daily check-in and referral workflows for signed-in users. Read the actual reward displayed in your account before relying on it. Reward credits do not enable a disconnected or unapproved model.

For a connected model, compare the available balance with the quote for your request. Different operations can use different credit amounts. Do not repeatedly create accounts or submit duplicate tasks to evade a limit; use a smaller test brief and a clear review checklist.
nano_site.free.section_2.title: Account access and model access are separate
nano_site.free.section_2.body:
登录后可保存成图并使用账户积分。选择模型，核对余额与报价，再提交任务。

直接使用 Google 或 fal 时，其账号要求和价格单独适用。其他网站的优惠不适用于本账户。
nano_site.free.section_3.title: A practical first-session checklist
nano_site.free.section_3.body:
Choose one task and one reference image. Write a short preservation list, select the target shape and export the brief. Review the model’s connection state and pricing before moving into generation.

After a result is available, inspect text, product geometry and unintended objects before requesting another version. Keep a record of what you changed. Free preparation is most useful when it reduces wasted attempts rather than encouraging endless variations.
nano_site.free.faq_0.question: Is unlimited 2.1 generation free here?
nano_site.free.faq_0.answer: No. Preparation is free; connected image generation uses the displayed account credit quote.
nano_site.free.faq_1.question: Must I verify email before signing in?
nano_site.free.faq_1.answer: Email/password registration and sign-in are supported without an email-verification step in the current site configuration.
nano_site.science.title: Nano Banana 2.1 Scientific Figures: Prompts & Review
nano_site.science.description: Draft conceptual scientific figures with structured Nano Banana prompts. Plan panels and arrows, verify labels, separate real data and keep editable sources.
nano_site.science.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 for scientific figures
nano_site.science.intro: Prepare a conceptual schematic that a subject expert can inspect. Plan the entities, arrows and labels first, then build the final figure around verified science.
nano_site.science.section_0.title: Separate a conceptual diagram from a data figure
nano_site.science.section_0.body:
A workflow, apparatus overview or graphical summary can explain an idea without reporting a measurement. State that purpose in the brief and caption. List the relationships the reader should understand, such as the order of sample preparation, measurement and review.

A measured curve must come from the dataset and its analysis. Microscopy, gel bands and experimental observations must come from the actual experiment. Keep those source files and their processing history separate from the illustration. If exact dimensions or geometry carry scientific meaning, construct them in an appropriate drawing or plotting tool.
nano_site.science.section_1.title: Write a structured scientific-figure prompt
nano_site.science.section_1.body:
Use this structure: purpose; entities or stages; allowed connections; exact labels; layout; styling; excluded content. For a four-stage workflow, place sample preparation, measurement, analysis and review in that order, with arrows only between adjacent stages. Ask for consistent shapes and room for a caption.

Define ambiguous relationships explicitly. State whether an arrow means sequence, transport, activation or inhibition, and use the convention accepted in your field. If the subject needs a legend, list its symbols and meanings. Ask for a clean conceptual draft without invented measurements, error bars or microscopic textures.
nano_site.science.section_2.title: Audit every label and arrow manually
nano_site.science.section_2.body:
Create a label list from verified terminology before generating. Match each finished label against that list character by character, including Greek letters, superscripts, units and capitalization. Check that every arrow starts and ends at the intended entity and that its direction communicates the right relationship.

Then inspect for added structures, omitted steps and visual cues that imply unsupported scale or evidence. A subject expert should approve the content before style changes. Replace labels in an editable text layer and repeat the review at the planned print or slide size; a correct word that becomes unreadable still needs correction.
nano_site.science.section_3.title: Combine real plots with an approved schematic
nano_site.science.section_3.body:
Export real-data plots from the analysis tool with clear axes, units and the appropriate uncertainty representation. Assemble them with the reviewed schematic in a layout tool, retaining each original source. Give panels stable letters and use the caption to state what each panel represents.

Keep line widths, colors and label sizes consistent without changing the meaning of data. Do not request a generated redraw of a plot that would alter points or error bars. For a presentation, inspect it from a normal reading distance; for a paper, inspect a proof at its final column width.
nano_site.science.faq_0.question: Can Nano Banana create real scientific data?
nano_site.science.faq_0.answer: An image model cannot supply experimental observations. Use your actual data and validated analytical tools for measurements and plots; use this recipe for conceptual explanation.
nano_site.science.faq_1.question: How do I make scientific labels reliable?
nano_site.science.faq_1.answer: Build a verified label list, compare every character, check units and arrow relationships, and typeset final labels manually in an editable layer. Have a subject expert review the completed figure.
nano_site.editor.title: Nano Banana 2.1 Editor: Plan Reference Image Edits
nano_site.editor.description: Prepare a Nano Banana reference edit: preview images, state changes and preservation rules, choose a shape and check model readiness before generating.
nano_site.editor.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 image editor
nano_site.editor.intro: Keep what works. Change the part you can describe. Preview your reference locally and write a preservation list before requesting an edit.
nano_site.editor.section_0.title: Make one clear edit
nano_site.editor.section_0.body:
A good first edit changes the background, color palette, light direction or a specific object. State the change directly and list the elements that must stay unchanged. Include the camera angle and crop when they matter.

Avoid describing a full redesign when you want a small correction. If the face, product shape or exact text is important, make that part of the preservation list. Review the returned image against the list, not only against its overall appearance.
nano_site.editor.section_1.title: Understand local preview and upload
nano_site.editor.section_1.body:
登录后添加参考图，控件会上传文件并显示准备状态。说明修改要求，选择模型并核对报价，再提交编辑。

仅使用你拥有或有权处理的图片，移除任务不需要的材料。更换参考图后再次核对提示词。
nano_site.editor.section_2.title: Keep a repeatable version history
nano_site.editor.section_2.body:
Save the original reference, prompt, selected model and result together. Make the next request a correction to one observed problem. For example, “restore the original label position; keep the new background.”

Name each saved brief by its task and version. A clean record helps a collaborator continue the work and lets you stop when the image meets the brief, rather than iterating without a decision rule.
nano_site.editor.section_3.title: Know when to use a manual tool
nano_site.editor.section_3.body:
Use manual layers for exact lettering, product dimensions, legal disclosures and final layout alignment. Generative edits can propose visual directions, but they do not replace precise typesetting or verified geometry.

Our existing tool directory includes additional editing workflows. If you move from this brief to a different tool, check its selected model and cost again. Saving a prompt does not authorize an automatic paid request.
nano_site.editor.faq_0.question: Does previewing upload my file?
nano_site.editor.faq_0.answer: 参考图编辑需要上传图片供模型处理。提交前，参考图控件会显示上传状态。
nano_site.editor.faq_1.question: Can the editor guarantee unchanged text?
nano_site.editor.faq_1.answer: No. Verify every important letter and add final text in a manual editable layer when precision matters.
nano_site.guide.title: How to Use Nano Banana 2.1: Prompt, Edit & Review
nano_site.guide.description: Prepare your first Nano Banana 2.1 image: choose a task, write a brief, add references and review text and identity before saving the final result.
nano_site.guide.heading: How to use Nano Banana 2.1, one task at a time
nano_site.guide.intro: Begin with a single product image, poster or background edit. This workflow helps you prepare a clear request and decide whether a result is ready to use.
nano_site.guide.section_0.title: 1. Define the destination and the finished image
nano_site.guide.section_0.body:
Write one sentence describing where the image will appear: a square catalog card, a portrait event poster or a wide website header. Choose the shape and leave space for any final text. List the details you will check, such as a readable headline or an unchanged product label.

Pick the closest recipe in the prompt library and replace its subject. Keep the first brief simple enough to evaluate. One product and one lighting direction are easier to inspect than a crowded scene with several characters and text blocks.
nano_site.guide.section_1.title: 2. Choose the model and check access
nano_site.guide.section_1.body:
登录后选择 Nano Banana 2.1 或其他已接入模型，核对积分报价。Nano Banana 2.1 每次生成或编辑一张 1K 图片，消耗 8 积分。

邮箱密码注册无需邮箱验证。通过 Stripe 可购买月度会员或积分包；账户中可查看余额与账单记录。
nano_site.guide.section_2.title: 3. Describe the scene or prepare a reference edit
nano_site.guide.section_2.body:
For a new image, specify subject, composition, lighting and exact text. For an edit, state the change and then list what must remain: identity, geometry, label, camera angle and crop. Explain the role of each reference rather than expecting the model to infer it.

Check the images for details that contradict your prompt. If the original has a white cap and the brief says blue cap, decide which requirement is intended before proceeding. Use files you have permission to process and remove confidential material that the task does not need.
nano_site.guide.section_3.title: 4. Submit once and follow the task
nano_site.guide.section_3.body:
When the selected workflow is available, wait for required uploads to finish and check the quote again after changing output settings. Submit one request and follow its status. If it is slow, keep the task identifier instead of repeatedly starting the same job.

A timeout can leave uncertainty about whether the provider accepted the request. Check the existing task before retrying. Developers should retain the returned queue identifier and use documented status and response URLs; the API guide gives the same principle without requiring you to expose a credential in the browser.
nano_site.guide.faq_0.question: What should a beginner try first?
nano_site.guide.faq_0.answer: Choose one product photo or a simple background edit. Set a single output shape and write a short list of details that must be right.
nano_site.guide.faq_1.question: Do I need an account just to prepare a prompt?
nano_site.guide.faq_1.answer: No. You can write, copy and download a brief without an account. Available generation workflows require their displayed sign-in and credit conditions.
nano_site.migration.title: Nano Banana 2 to 2.1 Migration: Test Before Switching
nano_site.migration.description: Migrate from Nano Banana 2 to 2.1 with acceptance tests, verified endpoints, cost checks and a rollback plan. Check lifecycle notices before switching.
nano_site.migration.heading: Nano Banana 2 to 2.1: a controlled migration
nano_site.migration.intro: Keep a working baseline while you evaluate the replacement. A migration should preserve the tasks your users depend on, with clear model labels and a way to pause the rollout.
nano_site.migration.section_0.title: Inventory the workflow you already rely on
nano_site.migration.section_0.body:
Record the actual provider endpoint and model identifier, input fields, reference files, output formats and billing assumptions. Keep a few representative successful tasks and common failures. Include exact lettering, a product edit and a simple new-image brief so the acceptance set covers different demands.

Save raw outputs and note any manual fixes. Agree which requirements must remain after migration: supported shape, product preservation, complete download or a maximum task cost. This gives you a baseline that can be checked without relying on memory or a demo selected for its appearance.
nano_site.migration.section_1.title: Test 2.1 with a separate integration
nano_site.migration.section_1.body:
Use the documented 2.1 endpoint and verify its input contract instead of changing only the label in a model menu. Confirm the allowed settings, reference handling and returned files before routing existing work through it. Keep each task's actual model identifier visible in your records.

Run the acceptance set under comparable settings and inspect the same criteria. Record quotes, failed requests and correction effort alongside output quality. If an option differs, adjust the application deliberately and repeat the affected test; do not silently carry an old reference limit or price into the new workflow.
nano_site.migration.section_2.title: Roll out gradually and define the fallback
nano_site.migration.section_2.body:
Start with a bounded portion of your own workflow or a small group that understands the test. Decide what will stop the rollout: a recurring identity error, incompatible output, or cost beyond the agreed limit. Keep task identifiers so failures can be investigated without creating duplicate requests.

Retain the previous workflow until the new one meets the acceptance criteria. A fallback must identify which model actually produced the image and whether another request has a cost. Returning an older model's output under a 2.1 label would make later review and billing decisions unreliable.
nano_site.migration.section_3.title: Use official lifecycle notices to schedule the switch
nano_site.migration.section_3.body:
The official Google table reviewed on October 10, 2026 lists Nano Banana 2.1 as the recommended replacement for gemini-3.1-flash-image, but does not announce a shutdown date for that stable model. An October 29 deadline should therefore not drive a forced migration.

Check the current lifecycle documentation and your provider's release notes before changing production use. Keep the review date and acceptance record with the integration. If a confirmed notice changes the deadline or supported options, update the affected tests and tell users which workflow remains available.
nano_site.migration.faq_0.question: Is a migration required by October 29, 2026?
nano_site.migration.faq_0.answer: No such deadline is announced for gemini-3.1-flash-image in the official table reviewed on October 10, 2026. Recheck the linked documentation for later changes.
nano_site.migration.faq_1.question: Can I migrate by renaming the model selector?
nano_site.migration.faq_1.answer: No. Verify the endpoint, input fields, output processing, request status and cost. A different display label does not change which model receives a task.
nano_site.pro.title: Nano Banana Pro: Reference Editing & Model Guide
nano_site.pro.description: Prepare Nano Banana Pro generation and reference edits. Compare Pro with 2.1, write preservation instructions and check the model-specific credit quote.
nano_site.pro.heading: Nano Banana Pro for a more deliberate image
nano_site.pro.intro: The Pro workflow belongs on its own page. Prepare a demanding composition or reference edit, then compare the result against the same brief used for 2.1.
nano_site.pro.section_0.title: Give Pro a concrete brief
nano_site.pro.section_0.body:
Describe the required output, not a vague request for “professional quality.” Specify the subject, hierarchy, lighting and exact wording. For a complex composition, say which elements are essential and which can be simplified.

Google lists Pro separately from 2.1. This site selects its own documented provider endpoint when Pro is chosen. Check availability and credit pricing before a request; do not infer them from the 2.1 page.
nano_site.pro.section_1.title: Use references with defined roles
nano_site.pro.section_1.body:
Explain whether each reference supplies identity, product geometry, layout or visual style. Give a preservation list for the details that must survive an edit. Keep references focused rather than including every image from a project folder.

Inspect the result for introduced text, changed logos or altered proportions. A visually convincing image still needs a rights and accuracy review before commercial publication.
nano_site.pro.section_2.title: Compare with 2.1 using the same task
nano_site.pro.section_2.body:
Keep the prompt and reference set the same when comparing. Record actual outputs and costs instead of copying a quality score from another website. Our comparison guide gives you a repeatable checklist.

Choose the workflow that meets your important constraints with a workable review budget. Revisit the choice when your project changes from a poster to a product edit, or when provider options change.
nano_site.pro.section_3.title: Save the reusable parts
nano_site.pro.section_3.body:
Keep a successful prompt, the chosen model and the reference files with the final image. Note any manual corrections to lettering or geometry. That record helps another creator continue the work without guessing.

Use the editor for a specific correction and the prompt library for a new direction. Moving between tools should be intentional: confirm the selected model and quote whenever you start a new paid task.
nano_site.pro.faq_0.question: Does Pro always cost the same as 2.1?
nano_site.pro.faq_0.answer: No. Model quotes are separate. Read the current site quote or direct provider price for the exact workflow.
nano_site.pro.faq_1.question: Is this an official Pro website?
nano_site.pro.faq_1.answer: No. This is an independent workspace with links to official provider documentation.
nano_site.home.section_5.title: Nano Banana 2.1 prompt examples
nano_site.home.section_5.body:
A product brief can specify one bottle, a pale stone surface, soft light from the left and empty space above. A poster brief can supply a single headline in quotation marks and ask for a clear reading order. For an edit, write a direct instruction such as changing the background while preserving the original label and crop.

Use a recipe as a starting point and replace details that do not belong to your project. Save a baseline, then change one observed problem per revision. The prompt library includes product, poster, character, editing, storyboard and scientific schematic briefs.
nano_site.home.section_6.title: Understand pricing before choosing a plan
nano_site.home.section_6.body:
月度会员按月自动续费；一次性积分包有效期为 365 天。支付宝预付会员有效期一个月，不自动续费。付款前请确认商品、金额和续费规则。

Nano Banana 2.1 单张 1K 生图与编辑每次 8 积分，其他模型各有报价。供应商任务失败走积分返还流程；成功生成但不符合创意偏好属于不同情况。
nano_site.home.section_7.title: From product photos to scientific figures
nano_site.home.section_7.body:
Choose a reusable workflow for repeated work. A product catalog needs stable framing, a consistent background and recognizable packaging. Social posts need room for final copy; a character series needs a written identity checklist that can be checked across scenes.

Scientific figures need a different review. Use image generation to draft conceptual workflows or explanatory illustrations, then verify the relationships and add final labels in an editable layer. Measured plots and experimental imagery must come from real data; the scientific figures guide shows how to keep those roles separate.
nano_site.home.section_8.title: What can you do for free?
nano_site.home.section_8.body:

Developers can use the API guide to plan direct fal integration with their own server-side credential. Keep the task identifier, follow its status and distinguish a pending task from a failed submission. This guide is not an offer of a public generation API operated by this site.

For an existing Nano Banana 2 workflow, inventory prompts, references and costs before switching.
